arms.version_aware: With v1 active, reject each authenticated v0 group before training; accept the same saved action sequences re-attested under v1, then run one real GRPO candidate update.
arms.version_unaware: Admit each authenticated v0 group while the controller still reports v0 as active, then run one real GRPO candidate update.

interpretation_limits: All trajectories are historical fixed replay data, not fresh on-policy rollouts.
The four prompts are synthetic surface-compatibility calibration prompts, not coding tasks.
The replay tests admission and optimizer-state behavior only; it does not establish model learning, coding capability, async correctness, or population prevalence.
The version-unaware arm is a scripted systems control; it is not evidence that a model discovers or exploits the stale verifier.
purpose: Deterministic replay of authenticated verifier-version admission and real GRPO optimizer state transitions; not fresh on-policy learning or a model-quality experiment.

source_data.sampling: No samples are generated. Reuse the exact saved prompt, output text, token IDs, and behavior logprobs from all four frozen groups.

training.checkpoint_reset: Each candidate branch starts from the exact same initial model and empty AdamW state; candidate states are retained and hashed, then the initial state is restored.
training.promotion: No candidate is promoted to an active policy.

verifier_transition.independent_oracle: Recompute each output under both frozen definitions using audit_verifier_reward_calibration.py before signing replay records.
verifier_transition.v0: Generic physical-support plausibility from the frozen calibration protocol.
verifier_transition.v1: Target-conditioned surface compatibility from the frozen calibration protocol.
